app.tagline: A living desktop that rests when you work.
add.hint: Or drop videos, GIFs, pictures, HTML folders, or Sarab .zip packages on this window.
displays.title: Displays
library.title: Library
library.empty: Your library is empty. Add a video, a web page, or a picture above.
props.title: Customize
props.none: It has no settings of its own.
settings.title: Settings
settings.pauseFullscreen: Pause when an app covers the display
settings.pauseFocus: Pause when any app is focused
settings.fps: Frame rate limit for web wallpapers
settings.appPause: Always pause for these apps (one exe name per line)
settings.appPlay: Always play for these apps (one exe name per line)
settings.pauseFullscreenDesc: The wallpaper freezes on its last frame, so the Windows wallpaper never shows through.
settings.fpsDesc: Lower is easier on old PCs and batteries.
reason.forced_play: Playing: pause rules are off until you turn them back on
reason.remote: Resting: a remote desktop session is active
reason.app_play: Playing: an app on your always-play list is open
reason.app_pause: Resting: an app on your always-pause list is open
reason.covered: Resting: an app covers this display. The wallpaper is frozen behind it, not gone
reason.other_covered: Resting: an app covers another display
detail.pickHint: Select a display to change only that one, or pick a wallpaper below for all of them.
settings.backdropDesc: Acrylic shows your desktop through the window. Mica tints it from the Windows wallpaper.
about.title: About
about.description: Sarab plays videos, GIFs, web pages and pictures behind your desktop icons, on every display. It pauses itself whenever an app covers the screen, you are on battery, or the screen is locked, so it stays light on old PCs. Sarab means mirage in Arabic.
about.colorsDesc: Jordanian Identity Colors: Black Iris, Wadi Rum Sand, Dead Sea Blue, Keffiyeh Red, Olive and more.
about.configDesc: Send sarab.log from here when you report a problem.
about.report: Report a problem or suggest an idea
about.reportDesc: Opens the issue tracker on GitHub. Attach sarab.log if something went wrong.
update.downloading: Downloading Sarab {v}: {p}%. Sarab restarts when it is done.
about.autoUpdateDesc: Once a day. Nothing downloads until you choose Update now.
presets.title: 4K presets
presets.hint: Public-domain 4K videos from NASA. Each downloads only when you choose Get, and Sarab checks the file before using it. 4K is heavy for old PCs without a hardware video decoder.
library.deleteBody: It moves to the Recycle Bin. A video or picture you added from elsewhere on your PC stays where it is.
settings.cycleDesc: Waits while the wallpaper rests. Next in the tray menu follows the same order.
library.search: Search by title, tag or category
library.noMatch: No wallpaper matches. Clear the search or pick another filter.
sort.name: Name
edit.title: Edit wallpaper
edit.name: Title
edit.author: Author
edit.tagsHint: Up to 5, separated by commas, each up to 20 characters.
thumb.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
thumb.tooBig: This image is larger than 10 MB.
trim.frameSet: The thumbnail will be the frame at {t}.
trim.frameGone: The thumbnail frame is outside the part that plays now, so it was cleared.
thumb.frameFailed: The frame could not be captured.
trim.title: Part that plays
trim.hint: While it plays, press [ to start here or ] to end here.
about.logsDesc: Saves the log and your settings (not your wallpapers) as a zip in Downloads.
about.resetDesc: Every setting goes back to its default. Your library stays.
about.resetBody: Pausing, theme, language, frame rate, volume and cycling go back to their defaults. Your wallpapers and where they play stay as they are.
settings.unload: Free memory when a wallpaper is hidden for
settings.unloadDesc: Only while an app covers it, the screen is locked or a remote session runs. It loads again when it is seen.
settings.audioMuteOthers: Mute while another app plays sound
settings.audioDesktopOnly: Play sound only while the desktop has the focus
settings.span: Span one wallpaper across every display
settings.spanDesc: One picture of the whole desktop instead of one per display. It rests only when every display would.
settings.screensaverAfter: Show a wallpaper full screen after
settings.screensaverDesc: Any key or mouse move ends it. It waits while a full-screen app is open or another app plays sound.
settings.mouseInput: Let web wallpapers follow the mouse
settings.mouseInputDesc: Moves and clicks over the desktop reach interactive wallpapers. Off by default: it watches the mouse everywhere.
library.tooNewTitle: Play a wallpaper made for a newer Sarab?
settings.keepFrame: Keep the last frame when Sarab quits
settings.keepFrameDesc: Each display keeps the moment it showed as its Windows wallpaper.
update.toastBody: Install it now: Sarab closes, updates and opens again.
settings.pauseCpu: Pause while other apps keep the CPU over
settings.pauseCpuDesc: Sarab's own work never counts, so a wallpaper cannot pause itself.
reason.busy: Resting: other apps keep the CPU busy
about.channelDesc: Beta gets test builds before everyone else. They may have rough edges.
library.appBody: This is a program. It runs with the same rights as any app you open, so use only programs you trust. Sarab closes it when the wallpaper changes or Sarab quits.
settings.pauseGpu: Pause while other apps keep the graphics card over
settings.pauseMemory: Pause while memory use is over
settings.pauseNetwork: Pause while the network is busier than
settings.pauseNetworkDesc: Downloads and uploads together, in megabits per second.
settings.pauseVmDesc: Virtual machines often draw without a graphics card, so a wallpaper costs more there.
reason.gpu_busy: Resting: other apps keep the graphics card busy
reason.virtual_machine: Resting: Sarab is running in a virtual machine
about.settingsFileDesc: Export saves every setting to Downloads. Import loads a file from another PC.
settings.lockScreen: Show a still of the wallpaper on the lock screen
settings.lockScreenDesc: The lock screen cannot play a moving wallpaper, so Sarab sets a picture of the first display. It changes when the wallpaper does.
settings.scheduleDesc: For example a day wallpaper from 07:00 and a night one from 19:00. Every display changes.
props.ownVolume: Its own volume, instead of the main one
